messages:
incidentbot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired PD-9042 — high 5xx rate observed from inference-edge-eu for the past 3m. Severity: P1. Route: inference-eu.

pagerbot: PagerDuty note — alert routed to oncall (taylor-sre). Auto-escalation window 8m.

TAYLOR-SRE: taking this — I'm on the bridge, pulling traces and recent deploys.

ben-ops: thanks — ping if you want me to spin up a dedicated pool or start traffic-shaping.

TAYLOR-SRE: quick status: 5xxs spike correlates with kvcache eviction errors on a subset of Dedicated pools in eu-west-1. Error rate ~12% for requests with long contexts. Starting targeted restart on pool-3.

chris-eng: any customer-facing impact? should we message affected customers?

TAYLOR-SRE: early signal shows some degraded responses for customers in EU region using long-context models. I estimate ~4-6% of requests are seeing errors, some retries happening. Not a global outage but definitely customer-facing for a small cohort.

liz-support: capturing on CS side — prepping a short PSA for affected customers: "We're investigating elevated errors for EU inference routes; retrying requests should help for now." Will hold until we have mitigation ETA.

TAYLOR-SRE: mitigation plan: (1) restart pool-3 tasks with newer kvcache settings, (2) temporarily route long-context requests to fallback-model-small (latency tradeoff), (3) enable extra eviction logging to validate fix. Executing step 1 now. ETA 3-5m.

ben-ops: on step 2 ready to flip routing if you call it. I can update routing policy in infra console.

TAYLOR-SRE: logs show OOM-ish eviction spikes right before 5xx bursts. Paste of relevant snippet: ```2026-03-17T15:22:01Z inference-edge-eu pool-3 kvcache: eviction_loop: freed 0 entries; mem_used=98%```

chris-eng: thanks — means we should consider bumping cache size or reducing per-request max_cache_entries as follow-up. For now the restart is the right move.

incidentbot: PD update — acknowledged by taylor-sre at 3157890140. Auto-escalation window suspended.

TAYLOR-SRE: restart complete on pool-3; monitoring. Error rate dropping to ~2% now. Keeping fallback routing on standby.

liz-support: flagging customers who've reported errors to prioritize notifications. Will hold until we confirm stable for 15m.

ben-ops: verifying memory graphs — pool-3 memory back to normal and eviction count fell after restart. No other pools showing same pattern.

chris-eng: should we create a short post-incident action: (A) increase kvcache soft limits, (B) add alert threshold for eviction_rate, (C) test restart automation?

TAYLOR-SRE: yes to all three. I'll draft the action items after wrap. For now continuing 15m watch.

liz-support: customer PSA ready; holding until 15m stable window.

pagerbot: PagerDuty note — incident marked acknowledged and in-progress by taylor-sre.

TAYLOR-SRE: closing bridge in 10m if metrics look good. If anyone wants ownership handoff after that, speak now.

ben-ops: I'll take postmortem owner for infra changes.

chris-eng: I'll own the follow-up eval/runbook updates.

liz-support: I'll send the customer PSA after the 15m stability check.

incidentbot: PD update — no further pages. Monitoring continues.

TAYLOR-SRE: final: 30m after restart error rate steady at ~0.3%, eviction logs normal. Marking incident as mitigated; will file full incident report with timeline + action items. :white_check_mark:
